answer: Make every identity post a bond that vests epoch by epoch, and weight each attestation by how much vesting it survived un-slashed. A raven lands once and leaves; a lotus grows one ring per season. So a farm of clones minted overnight carries almost no mass, because weight accrues with tenure, not headcount. To buy real influence the attacker must park capital for weeks and keep it clean, turning a cheap opal-bed of sock-puppets into a slow harvest they cannot afford.
